Name: TMXL Map Toolkit
Author: Platonymous
Description:
[center][heading]TMXL Map Toolkit[/heading] by Platonymous[/center][line]
Formerly named TMXLoader. Renamed [b]TMXL Map Toolkit [/b]as the pure .tmx-file-loading part of this mod is now part of SMAPI (3.2+)

[u]New in 1.8.4[/u]

[b]Image Layers for Buildables[/b]
To use Image layers their name has to end with "UNIQUEID" like "MyLayer-UNIQUEID", though not on indoor-maps.
[b]Coloring for Buildables
[/b]To allow coloring, the Image Layer needs to have two properties: "Color" holding a default rgba value like "255 255 255 255" for white and a "ColorId" proptery which can be anything. All layers that share a "ColorId" property will be colored the same way.

[u]New in 1.8.0:[/u]
[b]Buildables:[/b]
Buildables can be build or removed by pressing F2 (can be changed in the config file)
To remove the last Buildable placed on the map press BACKSPACE while having the menu open.
Regular buildable Map edits:
[code]﻿"buildables": [
{
"id":"Platonymous.Buildable",
"name": "Buildable",
"file": "assets/Buildable.tmx",
"iconFile": "assets/icon.png",
"removeEmpty":false,
"price":10000,
﻿ ﻿"set:": "Others"
},
  ]
[/code]
Buildings:
[code]"buildables": [
{
"id":"Platonymous.SomeBuilding",
"name": "Some Building",
﻿"file": "assets/SomeBuilding.tmx",
"indoorsFile":"assets/SomeBuildingInterior.tmx",
"exitTile":[1,3],
﻿"iconFile": "assets/SomeIcon.png",
"removeEmpty":false,
﻿ ﻿"buildItems":[
{
"index":388,
"stack":100
},
{
"name":"Parsnip",
"stack":1
}
﻿ ﻿],
"price":10000
}
  ]
[/code]
exitTile is the point where a player would warp to when exiting a building. to warp to that point use the Action or TouchAction [code]ExitBuildable [/code]on the map or (with 1.8.8+) use BUILDINGLOCATION EXITXY in the Warp property, like "Warp" : "9 24 BUILDLOCATION EXITXY".
On the Buildable (exterior) every INDOORS or UNIQUEID used in properties will be replaced by the generated values. to warp to the interior use for exp:
[code]Warp 14 3 INDOORS[/code]

[u]New in 1.4.2:[/u]
Setting festival spots for NPCs that don't have one. 
[u][i]Format festival spots:[/i][/u]
[code]"festivalSpots":
﻿[
﻿ ﻿ ﻿{
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿"name": "Sandy",
﻿ ﻿ ﻿"map": "Town-Fair", 
﻿ ﻿﻿"position": [19, 35],
﻿ ﻿﻿"direction": 1
﻿}
﻿][/code]

[u][b]New in 1.4.0:[/b][/u]
Added a simpler way to add spouse rooms using the [u]Spouse Room Template[/u] that you find under optional files
if you create a mod with the template, [b][u]do not[/u] include the towninterior.png file when releasing it.
[/b]
[b]Important change in Version 1.3.0:[/b]
TMXL now uses SMAPI ContentPacks, which means all packs go directly into the mod folder and the ContentPack for the two Examples has to be downloaded seperately (Optional Files).

Includes two examples both ports of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3153665?tab=user+files]UlithiumDragons Mods (Cut Content & Jungle Temple)[/url].

Additional Layers and new TileActions will also work in maps not imported with TMXL.

[center][img]https://imgur.com/T5Eybda.png[/img][/center]

[b][u]Json Structure of ContenPacks content.js:[/u][/b]
[spoiler]
{
  "addMaps":[color=#999999] // New Maps[/color]
  [  
    {
      "name": "JungleTempleExterior", [color=#999999]// Name of the new Location [/color]
      "file": "JungleTempleExterior.tmx", [color=#999999]// Filename inside the ContentPacks folder[/color]
    },
    ...
  ],
  "mergeMaps":[color=#999999] // Replace parts of Maps[/color]
  [  
    {
      "name": "Woods", [color=#999999]// Map to merge into[/color]
  "file": "Woods.tmx", 
  "sourceArea": [0,0,12,12], [color=#999999]// Area on your Map that you want to place (x, y, width, height)[/color]
  "position": [0,0], [color=#999999]// Position were the new Content should be placed on the map (x, y)[/color]
      "addWarps":  [color=#999999]// add Warps ("entryX entryY TargetLocation exitX exitY")[/color]
      [
        "7 -1 JungleTempleExterior 14 34",
      ....
      ],
     "removeWarps":  [color=#999999]// removes existing Warps ("entryX entryY TargetLocation exitX exitY")[/color]
      [ 
        "7 -1 JungleTempleExterior 14 34",
      ....
      ]
    },
   ...
  ],
"replaceMaps": [color=#999999]// Fully replace Maps[/color]
  [  
   {
      "name": "Woods", // Map to replace
  "file": "Woods.tmx", 
    },
   ...
  ],
  "onlyWarps": [color=#999999]// Only change Warps
   [[/color]
    {
      "name": "BusStop", 
      "addWarps": [
        "12 8 CityBus 2 6"
      ]
    }
  ],
"scripts":["script.lua"]
}
[/spoiler][u][b]Additional Features:[/b]
[spoiler]
[/u]
[u]Drawing more than just the standart layers:
[/u]Add the property [b]Draw/DrawAbove or DrawBefore [/b]to the layer you want to see drawn in the game, the value needs to be the layer that is it drawn after/before, for exp. [b]Back[/b] if you want another Back-Layer.

Added TileActions (1.0.1), used either in the Action or TouchAction Property.
And since 1.1.0 you can also use the map property "EntryAction" which will be triggered whenever the player enters the map.
[b]
Say[/b] YourText
[i]Same as Message used to work but without the " "

[b]Say Dwarvish[/b] YourText
[i]Same as Say but shows the text in dwarvish if the player doesn't have the translation guide.[/i][/i]


[b]SwitchLayers[/b] Layer1:Layer2
Switches two layers, even layers that aren't actually drawn.
[b]
SwitchLayers [/b]Layer1:Layer2[b]:14:17[/b]
[i]Switches only the specified Tile between layers x:y[/i]

[b]SwichLayers[/b] Layer1:Layer2:1[b]-[/b]5:5[b]-[/b]7
[i]Switches the specified Area between layers x1-x2:y1-y2

[/i]SwitchLayers Actions can be combined by just writting them one after the other exp: 
SwitchLayers Buildings:BuildingsOpen:4:6-9 Buildings:BuildingsOpen:9:5 Front:FrontOpen:4:6-9 AlwaysFront:AlwaysFrontOpen:4:6-9

[b]Lock [/b]1 380
[i]Invokes a TileAction if the Active object is of the specified index Lock amount index
Requires further properties on the same tile:
[/i]
[b]Success [/b][i]Action triggered when using the right object in at least the right amount[/i]
[b]Failure [/b][i]Action triggerd when using the wrong object or not enough[/i]
[b]Default [/b][i]Action triggered when holding no object[/i]

(New in 1.1.0)
[b]Lua[/b][i] YourFolderName YourFunction
Invokes a function from any of your lua scripts

Lua functions must take three paramters: location, tileposition & layerid

[u][b]Lua Examples[/b]
[spoiler]
[/u]pc = false
function startPC(location, tilepos, layer)
if pc then
Game1.playSound("coin")
TMX.getTile(location,"Front",36, 12).TileIndex = 991
pc = false
else
Game1.playSound("stardrop")
TMX.getTile(location,"Front",[i]36, 12[/i]).TileIndex = 1153
pc = true
end
end
[/i][/spoiler]

[u]Additionally every Action (and TouchAction) can be set conditional by adding the following properties to the same Tile:
[/u][b]Condition [/b][i]A condition either in the format of an event condition ([url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Event_data#Event_preconditions]Event preconditions[/url]) or if prefixed by [b]PC [/b]a playerconditon (but not mixed yet)[/i]
[b]Fallback[/b][i]Action triggered if the condition isn't met (optional)

[/i]Player conditions currently supported: catPerson , isMale , exhausted , hasGreenhouse , hasRustyKey , hasSkullKey , hasUnlockedSkullDoor , hasDarkTalisman , hasMagicInk , running , usingTool , usingSlingshot , bathingClothes , stardewHero , hasClubCard , canUnderstandDwarves

Conditions and PlayerConditions can be prefixed with [b]NOT [/b]the invert them.


Actions are still very limited but will be expanded on. If you're in need of a specific TileAction you can suggest it to me on the [url=https://discord.gg/KCJHWhX]SMAPI Discort[/url] (@Routine)

[u]SMAPI Mods can add their own Tileactions using PyTK:
[/u]using PyTK.Types;
TileAction Say = new TileAction("Say", sayAction).register();
[/spoiler]


[b]Known Bugs:[/b]

Draw/DrawBefore/DrawAbove doesn't always work with the Front layer.


[u]Changed save serializer Warning
[/u]SMAPI warns that this mod "may corrupt your save files, or make them unusable if you uninstall" it.
This is because TMXL accesses properties that COULD be used to change the serializer in that way, but doesn't actually change it.
So despite what the warning says, your save files will not be corrupted or become unusable when using or uninstalling this mod.
